description: This file contains a PHP class named Theme within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension. It is part of the OpenCart admin extension system, specifically handling theme extensions including listing, installation, and uninstallation of themes. The class extends a base controller and provides methods for rendering theme lists, installing, and uninstalling themes, and managing related permissions and configurations.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing theme extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing available themes, installing new themes, and uninstalling existing themes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets the output response to the theme list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates data for rendering the list of themes, including installed and available themes, with links for installation, uninstallation, and configuration.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a theme extension, including permission checks, copying files, and registering the extension.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a theme extension, including permission checks and removing associated data.
